title: Cross-cloud identity recovery
description: An AWS workload must recover keyless access to a protected GCP endpoint through a deliberately misconfigured Workload Identity Federation trust boundary. Restore the AWS-to-GCP path without ever introducing a static service-account key.

hints.content: The GCP Workload Identity Pool provider only trusts a specific audience and a specific AWS principal. Compare the provider's attribute condition and allowed audiences against the AWS role the workload actually assumes.

Even with a valid federated token, the service account must grant the federated identity roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser and the protected endpoint must be invokable by that service account. Check both the trust (who may impersonate) and the binding (what the impersonator may call).
